method: Predeclared format/size strata; choose the eligible bounded source in each stratum; SHA-256 seed orders topic groups for split assignment.
corpus_sampling: purposive feasibility pilot, not a random population sample

shortlist.reason: Fixed tag, concise standalone guides and original README; no executed include directives.
Fixed release HTML with complete code examples, table output and stable anchors.
Existing pinned 194-page real PDF; protocol domain distinct from packaging and Python language usage.
Deferred before scoring: requires pinning rendered pages or resolving external example includes; no incomplete includes admitted.

Deferred before scoring: need a separately bounded versioned manual subset for expansion.

source_sampling_limitation: No meaningful random draw among multiple eligible corpora per stratum occurred; do not describe this as random representative corpus selection.
split_algorithm: Sort connected topic components by SHA-256(seed|corpus|lexicographically-smallest-topic); deterministic dev/tuning/test capacity assignment of four positive topic pairs per split; seeded negative topic ordering, one pair per split.
gaps_for_expansion: A genuinely uneven multi-file README/wiki corpus
A real non-English corpus, not translations of questions
At least one whole-corpus holdout once five corpora are available
quality_thresholds: unset until independently reviewed pilot and evaluator rules are frozen
